meta.title: E05 · Headline — the payload as handed over vs fully equipped
meta.description: The single accuracy number. Frontline RF on, crossing grid, same 24 maps. A is the bladeRF exactly as the project started (bare SDR, no countermeasures). B adds the recommended analog front end (filter→LNA). C adds the three software countermeasures. D is the fused bladeRF+Kraken payload with everything on — the full recommendation.
